subActivities.title: AI-driven Intrusion Detection for Automotive Ethernet
description: Conducting research on AI-driven intrusion and anomaly detection for Automotive Ethernet, with a focus on unsupervised learning, robustness, and explainability.
Reproducing and extending recent deep-learning IDS research, covering network-traffic preprocessing, sequence modeling, multi-seed evaluation, and cross-dataset experiments.
